permissions.admin-shell:menu:manage: Manage the Admin Shell menu (global and role layers)

Global.title: Global menu patch
Global.description: JSON patch applied to the default Admin Shell menu for everyone: hide, rename or move sections and items, or add new ones

Role.title: Role menu patch
Role.description: JSON patch applied to the Admin Shell menu for users in this role; an item stays visible when any of the user's roles keeps it

User.title: Menu preferences
User.description: The user's pinned and hidden Admin Shell menu items

Appearance.title: Appearance
Appearance.description: Light, dark, or the operating system's appearance of the Admin Shell

Theme.title: Theme
Theme.description: The Admin Shell's colors: Virto, Warm, Blue, Indigo or a custom theme

CompanyName.title: Company name
CompanyName.description: Shown in the browser tab, on the sign-in page and in its footer. Empty: Virto Commerce

LogoUrl.title: Logo
LogoUrl.description: The logo on light backgrounds (sign-in page, Home): an image URL, for example one from Assets. SVG or PNG, about 200 x 48 px

LogoDarkUrl.title: Logo for dark appearance
LogoDarkUrl.description: The logo on dark backgrounds. Empty: the logo above

MarkUrl.title: Logo mark
MarkUrl.description: A square icon for the menu rail and the phone top bar: an image URL. SVG or PNG, at least 64 x 64 px

FaviconUrl.title: Browser tab icon
FaviconUrl.description: The favicon: an image URL (ICO, PNG or SVG). Empty: the logo mark

HelpUrl.title: Help link
HelpUrl.description: Where Help on the sign-in page and in the user menu leads. Empty: no Help link

SupportUrl.title: Support link
SupportUrl.description: A support page or mailto: address, in the sign-in footer and the user menu

PrivacyUrl.title: Privacy policy link
PrivacyUrl.description: Shown in the sign-in page footer

TermsUrl.title: Terms of use link
TermsUrl.description: Shown in the sign-in page footer

Showcase.title: Sign-in page panel
Showcase.description: The panel beside the sign-in form (from 1024 px wide): virto shows Virto Commerce's slides, custom the slides below, none only the form

Slides.title: Sign-in page slides
Slides.description: JSON list of slides: [{ "chip", "title", "body", "points": [], "image", "imageDark", "alt", "link": { "text", "url" } }]. A text can be a string or { "en": "...", "de": "..." }

Welcome.title: Home welcome card
Welcome.description: JSON: { "title", "body", "image", "imageDark", "links": [{ "text", "url" }] }, shown first on Home. {} hides it

Default.title: Default theme
Default.description: The theme of the sign-in page and of users who have not picked one: virto, warm, blue, indigo or the id of a theme file

Appearance.title: Default appearance
Appearance.description: Light, dark or the operating system appearance for the sign-in page and users who have not picked one

UserChoice.title: Users choose their theme
UserChoice.description: Off: everyone has the default theme and the theme pickers are hidden
